from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "From Secant to Tangent: The Limit Visualized"
        lines = [
            "We start with two points on this parabola.",
            "A secant line connects them to show average change.",
            "Watch as we slide the second point closer.",
            "The gap shrinks until it is nearly zero.",
            "The secant transforms into a single-point tangent line."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Positioning helper: The graph area is B2 to E5
        # This keeps it away from edges and lecture notes.
        
        # Create Axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-1, 3, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 5, 1],
            x_length=4,
            y_length=4,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True}
        ).scale(0.8)
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B2", "E5")

        # Function: y = x^2
        parabola = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, x_range=[-1, 2.2], color="#FF00FF")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "We start with two points on this parabola."
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Point A at x = 0.5
        x_a = 0.5
        point_a_coord = axes.input_to_graph_point(x_a, parabola)
        point_a = Dot(point_a_coord, color=WHITE)
        label_a = Text("A", font_size=18).next_to(point_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        # Point B at x = 2.0 (initial)
        x_b_tracker = ValueTracker(2.0)
        point_b_coord = axes.input_to_graph_point(x_b_tracker.get_value(), parabola)
        point_b = Dot(point_b_coord, color=WHITE)
        label_b = Text("B", font_size=18).next_to(point_b, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        
        # Adding an updater for point B and its label
        point_b.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(axes.input_to_graph_point(x_b_tracker.get_value(), parabola)))
        label_b.add_updater(lambda l: l.next_to(point_b, RIGHT, buff=0.1))

        self.play(Create(axes), Create(parabola))
        self.play(FadeIn(point_a), Write(label_a), FadeIn(point_b), Write(label_b))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # "A secant line connects them to show average change."
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)

        def get_secant_line():
            p1 = point_a.get_center()
            p2 = point_b.get_center()
            # Extend the line a bit
            direction = p2 - p1
            # Avoid division by zero if they overlap (though tracker stays > 0.5)
            if np.linalg.norm(direction) < 0.001:
                return Line(p1, p1, color="#0000FF")
            
            line = Line(p1 - direction * 0.5, p2 + direction * 0.5, color="#0000FF")
            return line

        secant_line = always_redraw(get_secant_line)
        
        self.play(Create(secant_line))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "Watch as we slide the second point closer."
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Slide B to x=1.0
        self.play(x_b_tracker.animate.set_value(1.0), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "The gap shrinks until it is nearly zero."
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Slide B to x=0.51 (nearly zero gap)
        self.play(x_b_tracker.animate.set_value(0.51), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The secant transforms into a single-point tangent line."
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Prepare Tangent Line at A
        # Derivative of x^2 is 2x. At x=0.5, slope = 1.0.
        tangent_slope = 2 * x_a
        tangent_line_full = axes.get_tangent_line(x_a, parabola, length=3).set_color(RED)
        
        # We need to stop the updater for the secant line before transforming it
        secant_copy = secant_line.copy().clear_updaters()
        self.remove(secant_line)
        self.add(secant_copy)

        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(secant_copy, tangent_line_full),
            point_b.animate.move_to(point_a.get_center()),
            FadeOut(label_b),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Cleanup
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset x to the right half of the screen
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.0
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center = (tl_pos + br_pos) / 2
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "From Secant to Tangent: The Limit Visualized"
        lines = [
            "We start with two points on this parabola.",
            "A secant line connects them for average change.",
            "Watch as we slide the second point closer.",
            "The gap shrinks until it is nearly zero.",
            "The secant transforms into a tangent line."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Create Axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-0.5, 3, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 5, 1],
            x_length=5,
            y_length=5,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": GREY}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "A1", "F6")
        
        # Function: y = 0.5 * x^2 + 0.5
        func = lambda x: 0.5 * (x**2) + 0.5
        graph = axes.plot(func, x_range=[0, 2.8], color=BLUE)
        
        # Points and Secant Logic
        x_p = 0.8
        dx_tracker = ValueTracker(1.5)
        
        def get_secant_line():
            dx = dx_tracker.get_value()
            # Handle the limit case visually
            safe_dx = dx if abs(dx) > 0.001 else 0.001
            x_q = x_p + safe_dx
            
            p1 = axes.c2p(x_p, func(x_p))
            p2 = axes.c2p(x_q, func(x_q))
            
            # Calculate slope and extend the line for better visualization
            slope = (func(x_q) - func(x_p)) / safe_dx
            x_ext_start = x_p - 0.7
            x_ext_end = x_q + 0.7
            
            line_start = axes.c2p(x_ext_start, func(x_p) + slope * (x_ext_start - x_p))
            line_end = axes.c2p(x_ext_end, func(x_p) + slope * (x_ext_end - x_p))
            
            return Line(line_start, line_end, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=3)

        secant_line = always_redraw(get_secant_line)
        
        # Dots
        dot_p = Dot(axes.c2p(x_p, func(x_p)), color=RED)
        dot_q = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(
            axes.c2p(x_p + dx_tracker.get_value(), func(x_p + dx_tracker.get_value())), 
            color=GREEN
        ))
        
        label_p = Text("P", font_size=18).next_to(dot_p, DL, buff=0.1)
        label_q = always_redraw(lambda: Text("Q", font_size=18).next_to(dot_q, UR, buff=0.1))

        # Animation Sequence
        self.play(Write(axes), Create(graph))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_p, label_p))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_q, label_q))
        self.play(Create(secant_line))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Move Q towards P
        self.play(
            dx_tracker.animate.set_value(0.001),
            run_time=6,
            rate_func=slow_into
        )
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Cleanup labels for final view
        self.play(Indicate(secant_line))
        self.wait(1)
